sentences.text:
Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:194563
Court No. - 66
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 34448 of 2024

Applicant :- Ankit Mishra
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.

Counsel for Applicant :- Atharva Dixit,Pranav Tiwary,Virendra Pratap Pal
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.
1.
Compliance affidavit filed on behalf of the State-respondent in the Court is taken on record.

2. Heard Shri Manish Tiwari, learned Senior Counsel assisted by Shri Pranav Tiwary, learned
counsel for the applicant, Shri Rajeev Dhar Dwivedi, learned A.G.A. for the State-respondent.

3. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.05
of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B, 34 Ipc & Sections 66-C, 66-D I.T. Act, Police
Station Cyber Crime, District Kanpur Nagar, during pendency of the trial in the court below.
4.  FIR of the present case was lodged on 01.02.2024 against unknown person and according to the F.I.R., the amount of Kanya Vivaah Yojana has been misappropriated by playing fraud.

5. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that nobody was named in the FIR but during investigation, applicant has been made accused in the present matter on the ground that in the account of his company about Rs.60,00,000/- were transferred, which were subsequently Ankit Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92374603/
1 withdrawn too.

entities.text: Ankit Mishra vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. He further submits that applicant and his wife are the directors in Atharva Vyapaar Pvt. Ltd. and brother of the applicant namely Udit Mishra was also made accused in the present matter during investigation and if, either he himself or with his connivance the account number of the company of the applicant and his wife was used then applicant cannot be held liable.

7. He further submits that merely on the basis of the fact that some amount of misappropriated money was transferred in the account of the pvt. ltd. company of the applicant and his wife, it cannot be said that applicant also involved in commission of alleged cheating and fraud.

8. He further submits that from the record of the case, it reflects that Vinay Prakash Dixit was the principal accused and according to the prosecution, he was the accountant and he used his I.D. and misappropriated the alleged amount but he has already been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 01.08.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.24085 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.24085 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 9. He further submits that brother of the applicant i.e. co-accused Udit Mishra has also been released on bail by this Court vide order dated 09.09.2024 passed in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.29366 of 2024.

entities.text: Criminal Misc. Bail Application No.29366 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 10. He further submits that all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist Class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 14.02.2024 i.e. for last ten months.
11. He further submits that trial of the case could not be even commenced and till date, not even charged could be framed.

12. He further submits that however, applicant was not having any previous criminal history but alongwith the present matter, he has also been made accused in one another case with similar allegation.
13. He further submits that therefore, considering the totality of the facts and circumstances of the case, applicant should be released on bail.

14. Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submits that it is a case in which huge amount of Kanya Vivaah Yojna has been misappropriated by accused persons and a very handsome amount of about sixty lacs were also transferred in the account of the company of the applicant and his wife, which was subsequently withdrawn too but could not dispute the fact that except the transfer of money in the account of the company of the applicant and his wife and its withdrawal,
there is no other evidence against the applicant on record, which can show that he was the person,
who by playing fraud transferred the amount in the account of his pvt. ltd. company.
15.
He further could not dispute the fact that during investigation alongwith applicant his brother Udit Mishra was also made accused but he has already been released on bail by this Court.

Ankit Mishra vs State Of U.P. on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/92374603/
2 16.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: He further could not dispute the fact that co-accused Vinay Prakash Dixit, the accountant, who allegedly used his I.D. and misappropriated the alleged amount, has already been released on bail by this Court.

17. He further could not dispute the fact that all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist Class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 14.02.2024 i.e. for last ten months and till date not even charges could be framed.
18. I have heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the record of the case.

19. However, it is a case in which huge amount of Kanya Vivaah Yojana has been misappropriated by playing fraud and about sixty lacs rupees were also transferred in the account of the pvt. ltd.
company of the applicant and his wife but it appears, as per the allegation, the alleged cheating and forgery was committed by co-accused Vinay Prakash Dixit, the accountant and he has already been released on bail by this Court.
20. Further, it appears during investigation, the brother of the applicant Udit Mishra was also made accused but he has also been released on bail by this Court.

21. Further, all the alleged offences are triable by Magistrate Ist Class and applicant is in jail in the present matter since 14.02.2024 i.e. for last ten months and till date not even charges could be framed.
22. Further, applicant was not having any previous criminal history.

23. Therefore, considering the facts and circumstances of the case discussed above, in my view,
applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
24. Accordingly, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the instant bail application is allowed.

25. Let the applicant- Ankit Mishra, be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:-
(i) The applicant shall appear before the trial court on the dates fixed, unless his personal presence is exempted.

(ii) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly, make inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
(iii) The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal and anti-social activity.

27. It is clarified that the observations made herein are limited to the facts brought in by the parties pertaining to the disposal of bail application and the said observations shall have no bearing on the merits of the case during trial.
